race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
race.verdict: PALMS OASIS continued his theme of race-by-race progress when opening his account at the third attempt in a C&D novice 3 weeks ago, defeating a next-time-out winner in the process. An opening mark of 74 looks fair on that evidence and he's selected to follow up. Blue Pete is another going the right way and feared, with similar comments applying to Henley on Thames . Lady Blanche also worthy of note in a good race of its type. PALMS OASIS BLUE PETE (IRE) HENLEY ON THAMES (IRE)
